notes.title: The Eightfold Path v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've just updated The Eightfold Path with all the improvements and bug fixes we worked on to get the game ready for its launch on Nintendo Switch tomorrow!

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/the-eightfold-path-switch/]The Eightfolf Path for Nintendo Switch[/url]

We can't be more excited about publishing our first game on Nintendo Switch! It took a lot of work but we're finally here :)

We had to make major optimization changes and now those changes are available here on Steam as well!

Remember you can check out the [url=https://friendlyllama.com/games/the-eightfold-path/changelog/]complete changelog for the game right here![/url]

Thanks to everyone who has supported us and enjoyed our game! We're already working on more games and can't wait to tell you more about them in the future!

[h2]See you![/h2]

notes.title: Meditation Music Released
notes.content:
Hello my dear friends!

I’m very happy to let you all know that a mix of [b]original music[/b] from [url=https://friendlyllama.com/games/the-eightfold-path/]The Eightfold Path[/url] created [b]specially to meditate[/b] was just released!

[b]Cris[/b] mixed together the [b]soundtrack[/b] that he [b]composed and produced[/b] to deliver this wonderful meditation experience, with sound effects and ambience from the game.

You can even get both the game and the soundtrack together in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47197/The_Eightfold_Path__Meditation_Music?utm_source=steam]discounted bundle![/url]

We really hope you can enjoy it, and that it can bring calm and joy to you. 🧘🪷

Take care!

Your friend,
[b]Friendly Llama[/b]

notes.title: Updated to Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi! I just updated the game to version 1.0.4!

It's got some improvements mainly on the earthquake sequence on the Effort puzzle. Also, the shadow darkness was limited so it doesn't get TOO dark!

Cris added the song from the release trailer to the incidental music and it fits perfectly!

And finally, we fixed some bugs like the bunny flowers not loading and doors being closed even though their buttons are pressed after load.

You can see the complete changelog here:
https://friendlyllama.com/games/the-eightfold-path/changelog/

There's still a few details that need fixing but they're mostly visual. Let me know if you see something weird that might be a bug!

Hope you're enjoying the game :)

Kindly,

Friendly Llama

notes.title: The Eightfold Path is now available!
notes.content:
It’s been a long journey but the moment has finally come!

Although we had to face many challenges and overcome difficulties (just like the monk) that came along with completing the game and launching on console and even had to delay the game!), we learned and grew so much and are very excited to see you all play and enjoy the game that we carefully crafted for you to play and experience 😊

This is also our first game on Xbox and we hope to reach more consoles in the near future!

Watch the release trailer:
[previewyoutube=x2HpYnGyOpY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy this game that we carefully crafted for you to take a moment and reflect on different aspects of life from the perspective of buddhism 😌

Can't wait to read your reviews!

Read full post on my blog
🔗 https://friendlyllama.com/blog/2024/08/the-eighfold-path-is-now-available/

Learn more about The Eightfold Path
🔗 https://friendlyllama.com/games/the-eightfold-path/


See you around!

[h2]Friendly Llama[/h2]

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’m very excited to announce that The Eightfold Path will finally launch on August 23 🥹

As many of you might already know, we’ve been working on this game for more than 3 years now! It’s been a long journey filled with challenges and great moments and I can’t be more excited to finally reach this moment and share our hard work with all of you!

In the game, you play as a buddhist monk on their path to enlightenment. You’ll explore a vast forest filled with magical places, beautiful creatures and engaging puzzles that will put your abilities to test.

Check out the new trailer:
[previewyoutube=T41-mAYRtF8;full][/previewyoutube]

Read the full post on my blog:
https://friendlyllama.com/blog/2024/08/new-release-date/


See you soon! ;)
